title: Add lock contention retry and in-memory failover to MediaStoreService

anchor.targetSnippet: async saveTrack(narrationId: string, audioBlob: Blob, timings: NarrationTimingsFile): Promise<void> {

violation.problem: MediaStoreService directly awaits OPFS operations. When concurrent browser tabs access the same file or quota is exceeded, createWritable() throws NoModificationAllowedError or QuotaExceededError, crashing client operations without fallback.
violation.expectedSolution: Add lock retry backoff and in-memory fallback in MediaStoreService so that when OPFS locks fail, operations transparently fall back to MemoryStorageAdapter.

steps: In studio/src/lib/media-store.ts, wrap adapter file write and open operations in MediaStoreService with a try/catch.
If the adapter throws NoModificationAllowedError or QuotaExceededError, initialize an internal MemoryStorageAdapter fallback instance.
Re-execute the operation on the memory adapter and maintain in-memory tracks for the duration of the session.
reviewChecklist: NoModificationAllowedError does not throw to the caller
Transparently falls back to in-memory storage when OPFS locks fail
Existing OPFS write and read flows remain unchanged when no contention occurs
